title: Add the ability to copy Bluetooth MAC addresses from the Bluetooth device details
line: The Bluetooth address on a device's page in System Settings can now be selected and copied.
explanation: The device details page in the Bluetooth KCM (src/kcm/ui/Device.qml) showed the address in a plain QQC2.Label, which can't be selected, so there was no way to copy it. The label is now a Kirigami.SelectableLabel: the address can be selected with the mouse or keyboard, and right click offers Copy and Select All.

commits.message:
kcm: make the device address selectable

The device page showed the Bluetooth address in a plain label, so it
could not be selected or copied when troubleshooting. Use a selectable
label instead, which also offers Copy and Select All on right click.

BUG: 514708

patches.diff:
From 9e5203530c8a0817116faf94bec1fe2af9f22530 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 21:15:32 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] kcm: make the device address selectable

The device page showed the Bluetooth address in a plain label, so it
could not be selected or copied when troubleshooting. Use a selectable
label instead, which also offers Copy and Select All on right click.

BUG: 514708
---
 src/kcm/ui/Device.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml b/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml
index 85814855..4d7f1e44 100644
--- a/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml
+++ b/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml
@@ -162,7 +162,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
                 Kirigami.FormData.label: i18n("Battery:")
             }
 
-            QQC2.Label {
+            Kirigami.SelectableLabel {
                 text: root.device.address
                 Kirigami.FormData.label: i18n("Address:")
             }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: dragging over or right-clicking the address does nothing
With the fix: the address is selected and right click offers Copy and Select All

review.text: Clean, idiomatic one-line fix in bluedevil's Device.qml replacing QQC2.Label with Kirigami.SelectableLabel for the Bluetooth MAC address. It preserves FormLayout alignment, enables mouse and keyboard text selection plus right-click Copy/Select All matching other Plasma KCMs, and is clearly verified by the before/after screenshots.

reviews.text: Clean, idiomatic one-line fix in bluedevil's Device.qml replacing QQC2.Label with Kirigami.SelectableLabel for the Bluetooth MAC address. It preserves FormLayout alignment, enables mouse and keyboard text selection plus right-click Copy/Select All matching other Plasma KCMs, and is clearly verified by the before/after screenshots.

The reporter's steps point at the KCM's device page, where the address was a plain QQC2.Label; swapping it for Kirigami.SelectableLabel (Kirigami already imported) makes it selectable with the standard Copy/Select All menu, which is the usual Plasma pattern and needs no new strings. The tray applet's device details already offer right-click copy of values, so the KCM was the only gap, and this closes the bug. The screenshot shows the selection and menu, the verify notes confirm the clipboard content, and the commit message matches the one-line diff.
